question: Show all customers from India
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, email, city, customer_segment FROM customers WHERE LOWER(country) = 'india' LIMIT 50;

question: List products with stock quantity less than 20 sorted by stock
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_id, name, price, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 20 ORDER BY stock_quantity ASC LIMIT 50;

question: Count the total number of orders by order status
ground_truth_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: Show all orders placed in 2024
ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, status, discount_amount, shipping_cost FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2024 ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 50;

question: List top 10 most expensive products
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_id, name, price, cost FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Find distinct payment methods used across all payments
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT payment_method FROM payments WHERE payment_method IS NOT NULL;

question: Show customers in the VIP segment
ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, email, city FROM customers WHERE LOWER(customer_segment) = 'vip' LIMIT 50;

question: List all returned items with their refund amounts
ground_truth_sql: SELECT return_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, refund_amount, reason, return_date FROM returns ORDER BY return_date DESC LIMIT 50;

question: Show top 5 customers by total number of orders placed
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC LIMIT 5;
description: 2-table JOIN with GROUP BY and LIMIT

question: List all products along with their category names
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, c.name AS category_name, p.price, p.stock_quantity FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY p.name ASC LIMIT 50;

question: Show total amount paid per customer across all completed payments
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE LOWER(p.payment_status) = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_paid DESC LIMIT 50;
description: 3-table JOIN with conditional payment status sum

question: Find orders containing products from the Electronics category
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date, o.status FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE LOWER(c.name) = 'electronics' ORDER BY o.order_date DESC LIMIT 50;

question: Show customers who have returned at least one item
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN returns r ON o.order_id = r.order_id LIMIT 50;

question: List items purchased in order ID 10 with unit price and line totals
ground_truth_sql: SELECT oi.order_item_id, p.name AS product_name, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS line_total FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = 10;
description: Itemized order breakdown with math expression

question: Show total sales revenue by product category
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: List customer names and payment methods for recent transactions
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, p.payment_method, p.amount, p.payment_date FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id ORDER BY p.payment_date DESC LIMIT 50;

question: Show top 5 best-selling products by quantity sold
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Find all customers who have pending orders
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, o.order_id, o.order_date FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE LOWER(o.status) = 'pending' ORDER BY o.order_date DESC LIMIT 50;

question: Calculate total revenue and total profit across all ordered products
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS total_profit FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id;

question: Show total refunds issued grouped by return reason
ground_truth_sql: SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS return_count, SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refunded FROM returns GROUP BY reason ORDER BY total_refunded DESC;

question: List customer segments with average spending per customer
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS total_customers, SUM(p.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id), 0) AS avg_spent_per_customer FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_segment ORDER BY avg_spent_per_customer DESC;
description: Cohort average calculation with division safety

question: Show products where profit margin exceeds 40%
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_id, name, price, cost, ROUND(((price - cost) / NULLIF(price, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS margin_percentage FROM products WHERE ((price - cost) / NULLIF(price, 0)) > 0.40 ORDER BY margin_percentage DESC LIMIT 50;

question: Count completed vs failed payments by payment method
ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_method, payment_status, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method, payment_status ORDER BY payment_method, payment_status;

question: Find customers who spent more than 5000 in total payments
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING SUM(p.amount) > 5000 ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
description: GROUP BY with HAVING threshold constraint

question: Calculate average shipping cost by order status
ground_truth_sql: SELECT status, AVG(shipping_cost) AS avg_shipping_cost, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: Show total discount given across all completed orders
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(discount_amount) AS total_discounts_given FROM orders WHERE LOWER(status) = 'completed';

question: Show monthly order count and total revenue for 2024
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS monthly_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

question: List all orders placed in the last 30 days
ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, status, discount_amount FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 50;

question: Count new customer registrations by month
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date) AS signup_month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

question: Show daily payment volume for the past 7 days
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', payment_date) AS payment_day, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, SUM(amount) AS total_volume FROM payments WHERE payment_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
